description: 3-year change in price-adjusted TTM EPS: current TTM EPS minus EPS 12 quarters ago, divided by price
1-year change in price-adjusted TTM EPS: EPS difference over the last year, divided by price
Earnings Momentum (EUR)
Reciprocal of the dividend yield–adjusted PEG ratio
Street Revision Magnitude: 3-month change in the median FY1 consensus EPS estimate, scaled

Net # of Revisions for Fiscal Year 1 : It is defined as the weighted average of the number of FY1 analyst earnings forecasts raised less the number lowered within a month, divided by the total number of analyst forecasts.
3-month revision in FY2 EPS forecasts: change in FY2 consensus earnings since three months ago, scaled by price

24-month active return with 1-month lag: percent change in stock price from month t-25 to t-1
6-Month Active Return with 1-Month Lag : It is defined the percent change in price for a stock from month t-7 to month t-1.
4-week Industry Relative Return: stock return over the last 4 weeks minus the industry average, scaled by the industry standard deviation
5-day Industry Relative Return: stock return over the last 5 trading days minus the industry average, scaled by the industry standard deviation
50-200 Day Stock Price Ratio : It is defined as the moving average of a stock's prices in last 50 days divided by the moving average of its prices in last 200 days.
Price Momentum (EUR)

Rational Decay Alpha : It evaluates stocks based on their historical 12-month market (S&P 500) adjusted excess return (the Y intercept from an OLS regression equation) using a proprietary rational decay function
Industry-adjusted 12-month Relative Price Strength: stock’s 12-month price strength minus industry average, scaled by industry standard deviation

Slope of 52 Week Price Trend Line : It is defined as the 4-week lagged slope coefficient of the least squares regression line of the last 52-week weekly stock's closing price against the corresponding weekly dates.
